1073|3a43ea84.name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
1073|3a43ea84.text: What did ya say, sonny?  You're going to have to speak up if ya want me to hear a blasted word you're saying!  All those years in the artillery have left my ears ringing!

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1244|e492be56.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|e492be56.text:
<Rethiel takes the Rotheap Innards from you.>

It is worse than I thought. The dark presence deep beneath us seethes with a malevolence that has seeped into the very fibers of life within the wetlands.

For now, I fear all we can do is combat its symptoms. Provide relief to the land and those who rely on it where we can.

Meanwhile, we must continue to look for the source. It roils... whispers just under the veil of the sounds of night.

Take this, as a token of my gratitude. May it help you further combat this madness.

1480|4d61ac25.name: Caitlin Grassman
1480|4d61ac25.text: Alchemy can help so many people! It's my life's passion.

1719|bf4c7bb7.name: Warden Thelwater
1719|bf4c7bb7.text: Over here, you worthless...! If you want to do something useful, listen quick!

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

263643|f9f7abf6.name: Sean Guardoff
263643|f9f7abf6.text: Greetings, $N. Do you wish to enter a battle at Darkspear Islands?

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

268568|f87f742d.name: Roy Lewells
268568|f87f742d.text: Literacy should be celebrated and shared.

268925|17da1992.name: Night Elf Courier
268925|17da1992.text: The night elf is motionless, with multiple wounds and discoloration emblematic of suffering from poison.

270637|3e0b4d08.name: Howin Kindfeather
270637|3e0b4d08.text: So many Wildhammer lives lost... whole families erased...

2817|de8ac2c8.name: Rigglefuzz
2817|de8ac2c8.text:
You must be hard up to be wandering these Badlands, $c.  Hard up like me.

Or maybe you're here because you're crazy.  Crazy, like me.

331|8fca8484.name: Maginor Dumas
331|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4078|8a5b6577.name: Collin Mauren
4078|8a5b6577.text: Hello, friend. What can I do for you?

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

7312|8fca8484.name: Dink
7312|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

1034-progress.name: Pelturas Whitemoon
1034-progress.text: Do you yet have the Stardust, $N?
1034-progress.title: The Ruins of Stardust

1054-progress.name: Raene Wolfrunner
1054-progress.text: The furbolgs' corruption has caused Ashenvale to become a fraction of its former glory.
1054-progress.title: Culling the Threat

1073-progress.name: Lomac Gearstrip
1073-progress.text: I can't make any Nitromirglyceronium if I don't have the potions... they're vital to its creation.
1073-progress.title: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun

1134-progress.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
1134-progress.text: Do you have the pridewing venom sacs, $N?  We cannot allow the orcs to use the beasts' poisons against us!
1134-progress.title: Pridewings of Stonetalon

115-progress.name: Marshal Marris
115-progress.text: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters?  Did you find the midnight orbs?
115-progress.title: Shadow Magic

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

1199-progress.name: Argent Guard Manados
1199-progress.text:
Blackfathom Deeps was once an ancient night elf temple. It once housed a most powerful moonwell. Who knows what evil brews there now at the hands of the Twilight's Hammer.

Have you made any progress in ridding their presence?
1199-progress.title: Twilight Falls

1200-progress.name: Dawnwatcher Selgorm
1200-progress.text:
Time is a precious commodity, $c.

My role here in Darnassus is to ensure that the Argent Dawn thrives and that the evil forces encroaching upon Kalimdor are thwarted.

State your business quickly or be on your way.
1200-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

126-progress.name: Verner Osgood
126-progress.text: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N.  If you're not ready for him, I understand.
126-progress.title: Howling in the Hills

1275-progress.name: Gershala Nightwhisper
1275-progress.text:
Once I have enough samples to study, my true work can begin. With the corrupted brain stems of both the satyr and naga of Blackfathom Deeps I can try to draw a correlation between the mutations.

Perhaps with that gained knowledge we can prevent the blood elves from delving deeper into deformity and evil.
1275-progress.title: Researching the Corruption

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

161-progress.name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
161-progress.text: You say somethin', sonny?  Can't hear a bloody thing besides the ringin' in me ears.  Say, what's that you got there?
161-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

174-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-progress.text: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
174-progress.title: Look to the Stars

177-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
177-progress.text: I showed Cog the beginnings of our star-viewing machine.  He was impressed.  Did you happen to find a reflective device?
177-progress.title: Look to the Stars

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

19-progress.name: Marshal Marris
19-progress.text: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense.  But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
19-progress.title: Tharil'zun

1921-progress.name: Wynne Larson
1921-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Jennea told me you would come.  Do you have something for me?
1921-progress.title: Gathering Materials

1938-progress.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
1938-progress.text: Do you have the book, $N?  Its secrets are not meant for the untrained, and plumbing its depths can lead to doom and ruin.
1938-progress.title: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic

199-progress.name: Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII
199-progress.text: Did you happen to discover any clues, $N?
199-progress.title: A Dark Threat Looms

271-progress.name: Daryl the Youngling
271-progress.text:
Ah, $N! Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!

...You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
271-progress.title: Vyrin's Revenge

289-progress.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
289-progress.text: In my dreams, I can sometimes hear the doomed moans of my brethren! Please, good sir, free them from the bonds and quiet their cries.
289-progress.title: The Cursed Crew

292-progress.name: Glorin Steelbrow
292-progress.text: That drunk Fitzsimmons sent you to me? Well, you can tell him I don't have any extra ale. He's going to have to panhandle someone else!
292-progress.title: The Eye of Paleth

293-progress.name: Archbishop Benedictus
293-progress.text: What is that orb you have? It looks...soiled.
293-progress.title: Cleansing the Eye

2953-progress.name: The Sparklematic 5200
2953-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
2953-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

296-progress.name: Ormer Ironbraid
296-progress.text: Is Sarltooth dead? Have you redeemed the memory of the fallen?
296-progress.title: Ormer's Revenge

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

298-progress.name: Jern Hornhelm
298-progress.text: Oh, a progress report from the site?  Very good!
298-progress.title: Excavation Progress Report

299-progress.name: Prospector Whelgar
299-progress.text: Have you uncovered the four fragments yet, $N?  Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru...
299-progress.title: Uncovering the Past

301-progress.name: Prospector Stormpike
301-progress.text: We Stormpikes don't like being bothered with trivial matters, $c.  I hope you brought news worthy of my valuable attention.
301-progress.title: Report to Ironforge

306-progress.name: Tarrel Rockweaver
306-progress.text: Were you able to find Merrin? Did she send word?
306-progress.title: In Search of the Excavation Team

34-progress.name: Martie Jainrose
34-progress.text: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
34-progress.title: An Unwelcome Guest

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

377-progress.name: Councilman Millstipe
377-progress.text: So long as a molester of the dead like Dextren Ward is permitted to live, justice stands betrayed.  Return to me once Lord Ebonlocke's sentence of death is carried out on that defiler, Ward.  We shall give the families of the dead the closure they deserve and better yet, we will send a clear message to the House of Nobles in Stormwind.
377-progress.title: Crime and Punishment

385-progress.name: Marek Ironheart
385-progress.text: Did I tell you about the time I almost lost my hand to one of the crocs? Nasty bugger it was, teeth like knives. But I was lucky... Jammed the brute's jaw shut with my knife. Still have the knife around here somewhere...
385-progress.title: Crocolisk Hunting

386-progress.name: Guard Berton
386-progress.text: Have you been to Stormwind yet, to The Stockade?  I fear whatever trickery that has kept Targorr the Dread alive for this long will eventually bring about his freedom.  He was sentenced to die, $N, not act as some political pawn on a noble's whim.
386-progress.title: What Comes Around...

388-progress.name: Nikova Raskol
388-progress.text: I see you are back, $c.  Have you collected 10 Red Wool Bandanas from those Defias Scum in The Stockade yet?
388-progress.title: The Color of Blood

391-progress.name: Warden Thelwater
391-progress.text: Either you bring me Thredd's head, or I'll take yours, understand, $N?
391-progress.title: The Stockade Riots

393-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
393-progress.text: Greetings. Of what service can I be to you, $c?
393-progress.title: Shadow of the Past

4601-progress.name: The Sparklematic 5200
4601-progress.text: It would seem that the device needs some sort of grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to get the contraption working.  So long as both are present, the Sparklematic 5200 should work...
4601-progress.title: The Sparklematic 5200!

4603-progress.name: The Sparklematic 5200
4603-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
4603-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

4604-progress.name: The Sparklematic 5200
4604-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
4604-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

464-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
464-progress.text: Have you attacked the Dragonmaw encampment?
464-progress.title: War Banners

465-progress.name: Dragonmaw Catapult
465-progress.text: The first catapult is before you. Will you set it aflame?
465-progress.title: Nek'rosh's Gambit

471-progress.name: James Halloran
471-progress.text:
My apprentice is like a son to me. It's going to be hard for him to live his life with only one leg.

Ah, $N, how goes it?  Do you have my skins?
471-progress.title: Apprentice's Duties

484-progress.name: James Halloran
484-progress.text: $N, right? Do you have my skins?
484-progress.title: Young Crocolisk Skins

531-progress.name: Vyrin Swiftwind
531-progress.text: Great job, $N! We really showed him! Here, give me the head and I'll take care of it.
531-progress.title: Vyrin's Revenge

579-progress.name: Donyal Tovald
579-progress.text: King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.
579-progress.title: Stormwind Library

7792-progress.name: Raedon Duskstriker
7792-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Darnassus for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7792-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

78142-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78142-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78142-progress.title: Bewitchments and Glamours

78147-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78147-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78147-progress.title: Crimes Against Anatomy

78148-progress.name: Garion Wendell
78148-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
78148-progress.title: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings

79091-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79091-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79091-progress.title: Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography

79092-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79092-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79092-progress.title: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal

79535-complete.name: Garion Wendell
79535-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79535-complete.title: Basilisks: Should Petrification be Feared?

79535-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79535-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79535-progress.title: Basilisks: Should Petrification be Feared?

79951-complete.name: Garion Wendell
79951-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79951-complete.title: Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead

79951-progress.name: Garion Wendell
79951-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79951-progress.title: Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead

81953-complete.name: Garion Wendell
81953-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
81953-complete.title: Stonewrought Design

81953-progress.name: Garion Wendell
81953-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
81953-progress.title: Stonewrought Design

84396-complete.name: Jennea Cannon
84396-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
84396-complete.title: Magma or Lava?

84396-progress.name: Jennea Cannon
84396-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
84396-progress.title: Magma or Lava?

86574-accept.name: Night Elf Courier
86574-accept.text:
<The unfortunate body here bears the marks of many strikes from the Pridewing wyverns. The pack nearby is rumpled and discarded, with its contents missing, and only a small note clutched in the courier's hand to indicate what was lost: a shipment meant for Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak.>

<The wyverns have probably carried off the supply bundles to line their nests.>
86574-accept.title: Stonetalon Supply Run

86574-complete.name: Innkeeper Faralia
86574-complete.text:
You found the missing shipment?

Oh, I had no idea that the courier didn't make it. That is... a tragic state of affairs...

I'll put these supplies to good use to make sure that her loss is not in vain.
86574-complete.title: Stonetalon Supply Run

86574-progress.name: Innkeeper Faralia
86574-progress.text: I hope that shipment comes soon...
86574-progress.title: Stonetalon Supply Run

88756-accept.name: Ashlan Stonesmirk
88756-accept.text:
The Dark Irons have a few camps east of here on Direforge Hill, and they've stolen a bunch of explosives from our construction site and hauled 'em back to their tents.

I don't need tae tell ya what kinda mischief Dark Irons can get up tae with a barrel o' powder!

I know the Dark Irons are dangerous, but we need those barrels back. You can tell 'em from other barrels because of the red markings on 'em. We cannae let the Dark Irons keep 'em!
88756-accept.title: Bring Back a Bang

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

91-progress.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-progress.text: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-progress.title: Solomon's Law

91899-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

92489-accept.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
92489-accept.text:
The Kirin Tor have long been allies of the Alliance. With the destruction of their city at the hands of the arch demon Archimonde, the once proud city of mages has now become reclusive and distrusting of outsiders.

In recent years they have begun reconstruction efforts to bring the city of Dalaran back to its former glory. However, reports show they are struggling to contain an outbreak of wayward arcane energies.

We must help them disperse these attacks lest we lose one of our most powerful allies.
92489-accept.title: Power Overwhelming

92489-progress.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
92489-progress.text: The Kirin Tor do not have time to spare, $N. Go to the city of Dalaran and put down the threat.
92489-progress.title: Power Overwhelming

94248-accept.name: Unknown
94248-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Blue Overalls, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94248-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls

94248-complete.name: Alyce
94248-complete.text:
The Blue Overalls! Thank goodness, I have a proper change of clothes.

Take this, and please be on your way. I do not have time to chat, I must keep an eye on the farm and can't risk more distractions.
94248-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls

94248-progress.name: Alyce
94248-progress.text:
Oh! Please keep your voice down--we don't need to draw any further attention to ourselves.

Do you have something for me?
94248-progress.title: Craftsman's Writ: Blue Overalls

943-progress.name: Archaeologist Flagongut
943-progress.text: With the Stone of Relu I will be able to release the hidden secrets of my fossil as well as Remtravel's fossil from Darkshore, $N.
943-progress.title: The Absent Minded Prospector

95647-accept.name: Caitlin Grassman
95647-accept.text:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.
95647-accept.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95647-complete.name: Unknown
95647-complete.text: I thought we were done for! Something upset the wildlife around here and our excavation team was overwhelmed. Thank you for helping us with those spiders.
95647-complete.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95737-accept.name: Llana
95737-accept.text:
From time to time, I correspond with others in my craft--herbalists or eccentrics who study rare plants and local oddities. We trade discoveries, and sometimes warnings of what lies ahead.

One alchemist in the Wetlands wrote of an excavation team her husband was part of, uncovering signs of a long-lost primordial grass... but she never sent word of its abundance or accessibility.

If you can, check on Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.
95737-accept.title: Seeking Caitlin

95737-complete.name: Caitlin Grassman
95737-complete.text: Llana must be wondering where those grass seeds are that I promised I'd have my husband bring back! It comforts me to know she's as concerned as I am. It must be something about the excavation site itself that we're both sensing.
95737-complete.title: Seeking Caitlin

95772-accept.name: Dorin Songblade
95772-accept.text:
Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation.

Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit.

Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time.

If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
95772-accept.title: Songblade Search

95772-complete.name: Unknown
95772-complete.text: This dwarf bears a striking resemblance to Dorin Songblade. The gun in his hands has the letters "DLS" carved into the stock.
95772-complete.title: Songblade Search

95795-accept.name: Unknown
95795-accept.text:
<You cover the dwarf's body with his cloak.>

Travel to Lakeshire and personally inform Dorin Songblade what became of his brother within the Excavation Sites.
95795-accept.title: Fallen in the Fen

95795-complete.name: Dorin Songblade
95795-complete.text:
Ah no...
<He buries his head in his hands and sobs.>

I should 'ave gone with 'em. 

Much of what I was smithin' was for 'im, was plannin' a surprise but it wasn't ready when he came by gettin' things for his journey.

Now that these are finished, I don't have it in me to reforge or sell any of it.
You can have this. It's the least I can do for you, bringing me this grim day.
95795-complete.title: Fallen in the Fen

95809-accept.name: Unknown
95809-accept.text:
I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out.

<He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.>

Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail.

Thank you.
95809-accept.title: Heartwoven

95809-complete.name: Caitlin Grassman
95809-complete.text:
Goodness, that sounds terrible!

By the light, I'm grateful he's one of the survivors.

<She holds the reed-woven heart to her own.>

I'll start cooking a hearty meal for him. Thank you for bringing me this. I'd like you to have something as a token of our appreciation.
95809-complete.title: Heartwoven

95809-progress.name: Caitlin Grassman
95809-progress.text: I'm more than worried about him!
95809-progress.title: Heartwoven

95810-accept.name: Unknown
95810-accept.text:
You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'

Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
95810-accept.title: Lost Relic Carry

96139-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-accept.text:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139-accept.title: The Valor Family

971-progress.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
971-progress.text: The journey to Ashenvale is long, and your task is not easy.  But if you get me the manuscript, $N...then your reward will be great.
971-progress.title: Knowledge in the Deeps

97237-progress.name: Roy Lewells
97237-progress.text: You forgot what you had to do the moment you stepped through the door, eh? Happens to everyone.
97237-progress.title: Shelf Picked

97914-progress.name: Baros Alexston
97914-progress.text:
I can smell the sea on you, friend!

<Baros laughs.>

What brings you to Stormwind?
97914-progress.title: Expanding Horizons

97926-accept.name: Baros Alexston
97926-accept.text:
I wish it was that easy to help, $c. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926-accept.title: Making Do

98155-accept.name: Turok
98155-accept.text:
The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!

I would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.

I don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.
98155-accept.title: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts

98190-complete.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98190-complete.text: You have my gratitude for recovering this. I am relieved it did not fall into the wrong hands.
98190-complete.title: A Friend of the Family

98190-progress.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98190-progress.text: Let us speak, $c. I can feel you carry something of the Light.
98190-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-accept.name: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon
98191-accept.text:
King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all.

The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.

It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathedral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
98191-accept.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-complete.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-complete.text:
By the Light... it looks just like his boy...

<Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker pauses for a moment.>

This statuette has indeed been blessed. Its connection to Terenas, its survival of what that monster did to him... this carries great power for those who believe in its strength.

It is best kept here for now, under guard of the paladin order. We will meditate on it further to learn more of its gifts, and perhaps it may aid us in dark times ahead.

Thank you, $c. Light bless you.
98191-complete.title: A Friend of the Family

98191-progress.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98191-progress.text: Light be with you, $c. You are clearly not here for small talk--what is it?
98191-progress.title: A Friend of the Family

98208-complete.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-complete.text:
It has survived! Oh, Elune be praised!

A thousand thanks, $N. If you are willing, I do have one more favor to ask of you...
98208-complete.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98208-progress.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-progress.text: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.
98208-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-accept.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98209-accept.text:
Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?

The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.

I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!
98209-accept.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
98209-complete.text:
The Nord'el survived? It cannot be... after all these years!

Our goddess is most wonderful indeed!

You have my thanks for delivering it here. It is a rare light in the dark times we have had of late, and a symbol of not only Elune's grace, but of the enduring will of our people to persevere without our immortality.

I will see to it that it is transported safely to Darnassus, so that it may be properly cultivated.
98209-complete.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98209-progress.text: I welcome you to Auberdine, $c. How may we be of aid to you in your travels?
98209-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98216-accept.name: Prospector Whelgar
98216-accept.text:
Old Gods?! This cannot be good news at all!

I've made out a new bit on the stone that speaks of a guardian of some kind. Whatever it is, it must be linked to the stone!

Take it with you and see if you can find a big Titan construct of some sort in the excavation. Read this here final passage on the stone and see what happens!

If I'm right, you'll activate the thing. Take it out if so, but try to preserve anything interesting! We simply must know more!
98216-accept.title: Understanding Our Present

98216-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
98216-complete.text:
Look there--see how the Goaz Stone starts to glow when near the keystone? I can almost make out some more words...

We still must learn more about this Goaz. I feel like we're just on the tip of the iceberg with something huge!
98216-complete.title: Understanding Our Present

98219-accept.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
98219-accept.text:
Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, $N.

I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.

There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.
98219-accept.title: The Shamed Lieutenant

98219-complete.name: Lieutenant Farren Orinelle
98219-complete.text: Ah, of course. Another one of Stormwind's finest here to check on me. Same as last month!
98219-complete.title: The Shamed Lieutenant

98221-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
98221-accept.text:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!
98221-accept.title: From the Ashes

98221-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
98221-complete.text:
Ironforge as well? Nek'rosh certainly has his father's ambition!

What he lacks, of course, is the enslaved army of red drakes that proved so devastating in the war. He's made a gambit, alright--one he will pay for dearly.
98221-complete.title: From the Ashes

98223-accept.name: Unknown
98223-accept.text:
This book has been badly burned--perhaps by the dragonfire that destroyed much of the Dragonmaw clan.

Of what little is legible, it seems to describe rituals relating to the use of the Demon Soul that the clan had used to control the dragons.

It is far too incomplete to be of real use, but based on roughly inserted pages on animal hide it seems Nek'rosh had attempted to salvage it. Freshly dried ink mentions a "Shadow Council."

Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor would want to know about this.
98223-accept.title: Old Habits

98223-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
98223-complete.text:
It's best we destroy this. Useful or not, we're not in the business of taking chances with any of those foul orcs.

The last thing we need are dragonriders on our doorstep!

And this Shadow Council business... most troubling. I'll send word to my superiors at once.
98223-complete.title: Old Habits

98223-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
98223-progress.text: I can practically hear the cries of the Dragonmaw from here! They deserve every bit of it and more.
98223-progress.title: Old Habits

98230-accept.name: Captain Stoutfist
98230-accept.text:
After the War of the Three Hammers that tore dwarven life as we knew it apart, the Wildhammers settled here, founding the mountain fortress of Grim Batol.

It was a wondrous place. Gryphons soared everywhere you looked, diving down through the wetlands to grab a fish.

It didn't last long, sadly.

Howin Kindfeather is one of the first Wildhammers to return in ages. Keeps to himself, far outside of town. Follow the road east--you'll find him eventually. He could surely use a hand.
98230-accept.title: This Land Was Their Land

98230-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98230-complete.text: If yer here to help, I won't say no. Help's awful hard to come by these days.
98230-complete.title: This Land Was Their Land

98245-accept.name: Howin Kindfeather
98245-accept.text:
I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode.

<Howin spits.>

I aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies.

These whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together.

The Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales.

Bring me a handful of the incisors.
98245-accept.title: Razormaw Needling

98245-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98245-complete.text: These'll make a beautiful set of awls. Thank ye.
98245-complete.title: Razormaw Needling

98245-progress.name: Howin Kindfeather
98245-progress.text: Any luck prying those teeth off? I need 'em whole so they don't snap on the scales right away.
98245-progress.title: Razormaw Needling

98246-accept.name: Howin Kindfeather
98246-accept.text:
I'll need some eggs if my plan is going tae work. Bassbeak needs a nice an' full belly--I ain't in the business of hoppin' on the back of a surly gryphon.

They need to be perfect--no cracks or anything.

Take some from the Razormaw raptors--they're known for having yolks the size of a $r's noggin. You can find 'em in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest.

Let's make it a nice even dozen, just to be safe.
98246-accept.title: Trying Times

98246-complete.name: Howin Kindfeather
98246-complete.text:
They're not for me plan--they're to feed Bassbeak. She's of no help at all if she's hungry, trust me. She might be more dangerous than the orcs if she's ticked off!

Untainted food can be hard to come by in these lands as of late...
98246-complete.title: Trying Times

98246-progress.name: Howin Kindfeather
98246-progress.text: The Razormaw won't be none too happy about you taking their eggs, so be ready for a squabble.
98246-progress.title: Trying Times

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label

98282-complete.name: Caitlin Grassman
98282-complete.text:
Oh, perfect! This is exactly what I need. You're a real hero, you know.

Please, I'd be remiss if I didn't share some of the fruits of your labors with you. Stay safe out there!
98282-complete.title: Alchemical Hazards

98282-progress.name: Caitlin Grassman
98282-progress.text: Have you had any luck? I know it's a pain to ask, but I really do need a whole gland!
98282-progress.title: Alchemical Hazards

98291-accept.name: Howin Kindfeather
98291-accept.text:
I plan tae get back into Grim Batol and reclaim it for the Wildhammers, $N. Or at least learn a thing or two.

Don't look at me like that, now. I know the risks. I don't intend tae go in hammer swingin', ye know.

Regardless, I'll need your help first. The Dragonmaw orcs march as we speak. They're all up an' down the Dragonmaw Retreat, where the red dragons routed them before.

I need you tae thin their numbers before I have any chance of gettin' close. Ye can't miss 'em if you follow the road east.
98291-accept.title: Death to the Dragonmaw

98310-accept.name: Prospector Whelgar
98310-accept.text:
There are other, larger golems all around the Wetlands. They each bear inscriptions marking them as Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru--matching the missing pieces of the Goaz Stone you found!

I'd be willing to bet if we can bring pieces of them as well, we'll reveal more of the Goaz Stone!

You'll find Ados at the Dragonmaw Gates to the east, near Grim Batol. Modr is right outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru's behind Direforge Hill, to the northeast.
98310-accept.title: Gleaning Our Future

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force

98815-accept.name: James Halloran
98815-accept.text:
The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?

I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.
98815-accept.title: Highland Hides

98815-complete.name: James Halloran
98815-complete.text:
These are some of the most impressive hides I've ever held; these will make spectacular detailing on all of my fine trim. Thank you, $N. 

Try these on and take one you'd like in trade.
98815-complete.title: Highland Hides

98815-progress.name: James Halloran
98815-progress.text: Welcome back, $c. Need any leather oil for your equipment?
98815-progress.title: Highland Hides

98895-accept.name: Alliance Brigadier General
98895-accept.text:
The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us. 

It is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98895-accept.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98895-complete.name: Alliance Brigadier General
98895-complete.text:
You've distinguished yourself honorably in battle at the Darkspear Islands and your efforts have not gone unnoticed.

There are ever more battles to fight, however. Continue to prove yourself in battle and you will surely reap the rewards.
98895-complete.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98895-progress.name: Alliance Brigadier General
98895-progress.text: How goes your campaign in the Darkspear Islands, $N?
98895-progress.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98896-complete.name: Alliance Brigadier General
98896-complete.text:
Excellent work, $c! With each blow struck against the Darkspear Raiders, we move one step closer to total victory. 

For the Alliance!
98896-complete.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98896-progress.name: Alliance Brigadier General
98896-progress.text: The fight in the Darkspear Islands continues, $N. Rally your forces and crush the Darkspear Raiders!
98896-progress.title: Darkspear Islands Clash
